judges.critique:
**Strengths**
- Layout, composition and palette of all four tiles match closely: positions of the gauge, pill, phone, wheel, and the confetti avatar field line up almost 1:1.
- Colors (lime, coral deposit gradient, peach background, lake photo, pastel avatars) are very close; the Deposit button and Cero notification are near-exact.
- Typography families are right (serif headings, grotesk labels, monospace balance).

**Differences (priority order)**
1. [TL] 0.1-2.0s, node cards: icon glyphs are smaller and thinner than REF (wallet, card, bank, CEX arrows, Socials badge fill ~60% of circle in REF, ~45% in NEW). Enlarge glyphs about 1.3x with heavier stroke; Socials badge should be a scalloped seal. Bank glyph should be the taller classic columned building.
2. [TL] 0.1-1.9s, card text: serif title is about 4px (at 1080p-scale) too high and slightly lighter/narrower than REF; subtitle two-line leading differs; the +N badge pill is lighter and the + glyph is grey (REF is dark). Move title down about 3px, darken the + and badge fill, bump title weight.
3. [TL] 2.3-2.9s, gauge: REF has dense, thick tick marks with a fading lime fill under the arc. NEW ticks are thinner and the arc shows a gray unfilled section at 2.3s (REF fully lime). Number digits in REF are larger and heavier (1000 at 2.9s), while NEW has a lighter weight. The mini node labels are slightly larger in NEW.
4. [TL] 3.4-5.8s, phone UI: NEW phone is shifted about 10px right and is slightly narrower at 3.4s. The Credit line locked card is flatter gray; REF has more frosted blur and the lime blob inside the unlock card at 4.4s is soft, NEW's is a hard-edged blob. Rewards value, Lottery badge and sparkle sizes are slightly small. Header text 'Score' is smaller.
5. [BR] 1.35-3.4s, wheel: REF wheel segments have more contrast (alternating bright/darker lime) and rim dots are larger and sit on a thin rim; NEW rim is thicker olive and dots smaller. REF Salary text is lighter gray with bigger $ digits at 3.4s; NEW is bolder and a touch smaller. Outer halo rings in 2.5-2.9s are subtler in NEW.
6. [BL] 0.2-3.2s: 'Spend crypto' text matches but NEW is about 5px left. Net Worth number in NEW slightly larger and bolder monospace; the phone mockup in NEW is slightly narrower/offset left at 1.4s. The orange/red flame glows at the sides are thinner in NEW. Deposit pill text slightly smaller than REF.
7. [TR] 1.0-2.9s: wallet row matches; the avatar face (eyes/mouth) in NEW is darker and bigger; the row text is about 2% smaller. The confetti faces in REF have thinner features.

Overall the same design with several noticeable detail differences, particularly icon scale, gauge texture and wheel contrast.

**Strengths**
- Cut timing and loop sync are essentially frame-matched across all four quadrants (TL card swaps, TR phone cut to ticker, BL Deposit-to-text cut, BR wheel settle/zoom); same scene order at 1.0/3.0/6.5/9.0/12.0/13.5/14.5s.
- Transition types are right: unlock glass-card morph, wheel blur-in then zoom, odometer rolling digits, word-by-word text reveal.
- Easing of the wheel/zoom and Deposit button squash reads very close.

**Differences (prioritized)**
1. [BR] 2.6-3.6s and 12-14s: salary odometer is out of phase. REF at 2.6s shows rolling mid-digit blur ($34..), NEW shows a clean $3335; REF rolls faster early (reaches ~$4400 by about 0.4s earlier than NEW's $3787 at equal timestamp). Fix: start the roll earlier and use a stronger ease-out (faster ramp), and keep digit-roll blur/vertical offset on every digit, not only the last two.
2. [TL] 1.4-3.0s: gauge odometer. REF rolls with blurred ghost digits stacked above/below at 2.6s (1998 shows heavy roll); NEW shows nearly settled 1999. At 1.0s REF stays on 1000 while NEW is similar, but NEW settles about 1-2 frames early. Fix: delay the final settle, lengthen the roll tail, and add motion blur on the rolling digits.
3. [TL] Card badge counters (+38 vs +40 at 0.15s; +27 vs +26 at 1.4s; +18 vs +20 at 6.5s; +47 vs +45 at 13.5s): the count-up leads or lags by 1-2 values. Fix: tune the count-up easing and delay so values match at card entry; the entering icon (Card Spending) also starts at a different scale (NEW smaller at +20).
4. [TR] 4.6-5.6s unlock: REF glass card is more opaque grey with heavier blur and the green fills with a slower radial bloom; NEW goes green and clean sooner and the card is wider at 5.6s. Fix: lengthen grey-to-green bloom by about 2-3 frames and increase backdrop blur early in the unlock.
5. [BL] 0.15s/7.9s text: NEW shows the next word ("as") one frame earlier than REF (0.15s: REF "Spend crypto" only vs NEW "Spend crypto as"). Words land 1 frame early; delay stagger by about 0.05-0.1s. Words also settle with slightly more y-drop in REF.
6. [BR] 10.8s: wheel number roll shows differently positioned ghost digits, and the 2x label travels at slightly different angle during spin (3.6s ring blur). Match spin rotation phase at the cut.
7. [TL] Gauge arc fill at 2.6s: REF has the green arc sweeping with tick-mark reveal further along; NEW slightly lagging; align sweep easing.

Overall the same video at normal speed; remaining gaps are mainly odometer phase and motion blur on rolling digits.

**Strengths**
- Layout, palette, typography, bubble field, phone mock, Deposit pill and lime wheel all read as the same video; timing of transitions is tightly matched.
- Glass and glow work (credit-line frosted card turning lime, notification glass, wheel halo rings) is present and convincing.

**Differences, by impact**
1. [BR] 2.5-3.4s: REF wheel-hub counter is a fast vertical slot roll with clipped digit slivers ($322', $5o4'), and the white ring bursts out at ~2.9s. NEW shows clean digits that lag the REF number ($3200 at 2.45s vs REF mid-roll; $4898 vs $5o4'). Fix: start the roll ~0.2s earlier, add stronger vertical motion blur and masking, and sync the ring burst.
2. [BR] 1.35-2.0s and 7.9s: REF zoomed wheel is more heavily defocused with a soft white vignette and low-contrast saturation, and a cooler, paler lime. NEW is more saturated and sharper, with a darker green edge and a larger hub. Fix: raise blur at the start of the zoom-out, lighten the lime (REF ~#c8ff10), reduce the dark rim.
3. [TL] 2.3-2.45s: REF gauge number is a motion-smeared roll (855, 1998 with vertical streaks); NEW shows clipped digits or a static number, and the arc fill and tick colors differ. Fix: add vertical blur and ghost digits, and match the arc fill progress at those timestamps.
4. [TL] 0.1-1.9s card sequence: NEW satellite order and content diverge (REF On-chain Wallets at 0.8s, NEW Card Spending), the score pill is slightly off (+40 vs +38) and the title sits a few px higher. Fix: reorder the cards, match the pill offset, and lower the title baseline about 3px.
5. [TL] 4.4-4.7s credit line: REF frosted card is heavy gray with strong blur and the lock glow appears late; NEW is already lime at 4.7s with a brighter glow. Fix: delay the lime tint ~0.15s, increase blur and gray opacity, and reduce the lock halo.
6. [BL] 2.2s: REF Deposit button text fades in place with a pale pink fill; NEW shows an empty blob, so the label is missing. Fix: keep the label visible at reduced opacity. Pill gradient at 2.6s is also smoother and lighter in REF, with a grainy peach bottom glow that NEW lacks. Add subtle noise or grain.
7. [TR] 1.0-2.2s: REF fading bubbles are slightly more washed and larger; the address row sits about 20px left and the pill is a touch larger. Fix: shift the row left and enlarge the avatar.
8. [BR] 0.4s: REF phone bezel is a thinner dark rim with a slight highlight; NEW bezel is thicker and flatter, and the notification card is slightly lower with less frost. Fix: thin the bezel, add a rim highlight, and raise the card about 4px.
9. General: text weight and antialiasing differ slightly (the NEW digits look heavier and slightly larger, the Cash held title is smaller).

notes: First integrated build: 4 quadrants built in parallel (TL gauge/phone/credit, TR wallet bubbles, BL spend/deposit, BR salary wheel).

judges.critique:
- Strengths: layout, quadrant composition, palette and fonts (serif titles, grotesk body, mono net-worth) match closely; phone mockups, wheel, avatars and deposit pill read as the same design.
- Strengths: icon set, ring colors and text content are nearly identical across all four tiles.

Prioritized differences:
1. [BR] 1.35-2.0s: wheel is too large and too saturated and flat. REF at 1.35 shows a paler, softly blurred wheel with a visible radial wedge pattern and a lighter center spike. NEW is a heavier, darker green with the bubble sitting lower. Fix: scale the wheel down about 5%, add wedge contrast and blur, and move the Salary bubble and its spike up.
2. [BR] 3.4s and 10.8s: the Salary/$ text in the big white circle sits lower and is bolder and darker than REF (REF is lighter weight, y higher). The outer halo ring is thicker in REF. Fix: lighten the weight, raise the text about 6px at 960 scale, and thin the ring.
3. [TR] 2.3-2.9s: the gauge in NEW has tick bars that are shorter and thicker, and a gray unfilled wedge at 2.3s that REF lacks (REF is fully green). The REF 1000 numeral is larger and heavier. Fix: enlarge the numeral, lengthen the ticks, and fill the arc.
4. [TL] 4.4-4.7s (phone Credit line card): REF is opaque gray frosted glass with a white padlock and no hard edges. NEW is more translucent and shows a visible bounding edge, with the lock icon dimmer. Fix: add backdrop blur with a gray tint of about 0.85 alpha, and a bigger, brighter lock.
5. [TL] 5.3-5.8s: the credit line card in NEW has a larger "$248/$500 left" and a lower progress bar, with an off-white card. Reward value and card y are offset by about 4px. Fix: match the card y offset and the amount font size.
6. [TL, mid] Cash held title (0.1s, 6.5s, 12s): the NEW title serif is about 2px higher and lighter in weight, and the ring arc is thicker and brighter than REF's thin arc. Also the +N badge is bigger and the tile subtitle sits about 3px higher. Fix: thin the ring stroke, reduce the badge size, and nudge the type down.
7. [BL] 1.4-2.2s: the phone status bar and chip row in NEW are 1-2px higher than REF and the chip icons are heavier. Fix: shift down 2px and use lighter icon strokes. The orange flame edges in NEW are a harder, more saturated red at 1.8s. Fix: soften the gradient.
8. [BL] 0.2s: the "Spend crypto as" text is slightly larger in NEW and the background gradient is smoother, with no peach grain/noise as in REF. Fix: add a subtle noise overlay.
9. [TR] 2.6-2.9s: the avatar row text is slightly bolder and the avatar a little larger. Fix: reduce the weight.

**Strengths**
- Cut timing, loop sync and sequencing match across all four quadrants. Cards, unlock, wheel spin-to-zoom, bubble to wallet row, and the Deposit morph all land within about 1-2 frames over the 14.7s loop.
- Easing and transition types are faithful: the unlock blur-to-green sweep, wheel blur-to-sharp spin, deposit button scale and pan, and the word-by-word 'Spend crypto as you go'.
- Odometer behavior is present in all four spots (score, salary, card counters), with the same blur and roll feel.

**Differences, most impactful first**
1. [BR] 12.0s and 13.5s: the Salary odometer is out of phase. REF at 13.5s shows '$6_50' with digits mid-roll and slightly lower, while NEW shows '$62' with a different roll. At 3.6s of the early spin NEW reads $3204 / $3540 / $4218 against REF $3200 / $3513 / $4429. Fix by matching the counter's value-vs-time curve, with a slightly faster ramp early, and by matching per-digit roll phase and stagger.
2. [TL] 2.6s (and 9.0s): the score odometer digits differ. REF at 2.6s shows '1998' with the second '9' already rolling and a small gap between the two lines. NEW shows '1999' with bigger vertical offset and blur. The final '1000' lands cleanly in both, but the ticks inside the roll run 1-2 frames fast. Reduce the digit-roll offset and delay the last digit's settle.
3. [TL] 4.6s unlock card: REF's glass slab is wider, more opaque grey and blurred, with a sharper bright-green core. NEW's is greener and more diffuse, and its edges are less frosted. At 10.8s REF is more saturated and opaque while NEW looks translucent. Slow the grey-to-green crossfade, and delay and sharpen the radial core.
4. [BR] 0.15-1.4s: the wheel exit and entry blur. REF's wheel is larger and more zoomed at 1.4s and more motion-blurred (blur kernel is bigger). The 2x tick label sits at a different rotation angle in the first frames of the spin. Increase the initial scale and blur, and shift the spin phase by about 1 frame.
5. [TL] Small count-up chips: the +N badge leads or lags by 1 step in several frames (REF +27 vs NEW +26 at 1.4s, +38/+40 at 0.15s, +69/+64 at 7.9s). The ring-fill sweep during the card swap is also slightly offset. Retune the number easing, probably to ease-out, and the start offset.
6. [TR] 4.6-5.6s: wallet row and zoom. Matches in timing. The only difference is that REF's avatar and text drift is slightly larger at 4.6s. Minor.
7. [BL] 5.6s: phone slides and the 'Rewards' tile lag. REF's values read $50.79 / $306 against NEW $50.90 / $307, so the counter eases differently. Match the easing curve.

- Layout, palette, typography, timing and choreography are essentially a 1:1 match; all four quadrants stay in sync through every transition.
- Wheel zoom-out, chat-bubble field, phone/lake notification and gauge-to-phone transitions read as the same video at normal speed.

**Differences, by impact**
1. [BL 2.6-3.2, 12.0-13.5] Deposit button: REF is a saturated orange-red gradient with soft mottled blur patches and a glassy edge. NEW has a pale pink/salmon wash in the middle and a crisper edge, so it looks flatter and lighter. Fix: deepen the center fill to the REF orange, blur the inner highlight blobs more, and soften the rim.
2. [BL 0-3, 12.0] Background: REF has a fine sparkle/grain speckle and a diagonal-streak gradient (peach to white) that drifts. NEW is a smooth vertical gradient with no grain. Fix: add a subtle noise/sparkle overlay and the diagonal streak flow, and put more peach glow at the bottom edge.
3. [TL 2.3-3.0] Gauge: REF ticks vary in length and fade down into a luminous green floor glow that fills the lower half of the tile. NEW ticks are uniform, thinner and paler, with a weaker floor glow and a clearly visible grey inner ring. Fix: lengthen and thicken the ticks, add the green radial glow at the base, and reduce the inner ring contrast. Also the digit roll at 2.3 and 2.9 shows different glyph fragments (REF is a tight clipped ticker, NEW is blurrier and larger).
4. [TL 4.4-4.7, 10.8] Credit line unlock: REF has a frosted grey glass slab with a strong backdrop blur, and a green radial glow blooming from the lock. NEW is flatter and more translucent, with the green wash spread evenly and less frost. Fix: raise the backdrop blur and grey frost, and add a radial gradient plus a soft bloom around the lock.
5. [BR 2.5-3.9] Wheel rim and glow: REF has a darker olive rim, a bright white halo ring and brighter yellow-green wedges. NEW has a lighter rim, a milkier halo and slightly duller wedges. The "Salary" digit-roll glyphs also differ (REF shows sliced fragments, NEW more legible digits). Fix: darken the rim stroke, boost wedge saturation and halo contrast, and tighten the roll mask.
6. [TR 0.4-1.4, 13.5] Phone/lake: REF's phone sits slightly lower and wider, with a stronger specular edge and a hazier lake. NEW is a bit smaller, with a sharper, darker lake and a drop shadow below the bezel. Fix: remove the shadow, soften the lake, and scale up about 3%.
7. [TL 0.1-1.9] Chip titles and badges sit a few px off. NEW titles are about 3px higher, the badge numbers differ by 1-2 counts per frame (+26 vs +27), and the icon glyphs are bolder. Fix: nudge baselines down, thin the icon strokes, and retime the badge counters.
8. [BR 1.35] Wheel blur-in: REF has a heavier gaussian blur with a visible white vignette. NEW is slightly sharper at the edges.
9. [TR 2.2-2.9] The wallet row spacing is slightly wider in NEW (the $27.70M column is offset by a few px).

notes: Round 2: judge critiques applied per quadrant after verifying each against reference. Odometers roll continuously with blur + ghost digits (TL/BR), bigger TL icons, later glass bloom, BR salary curve matched to 23 sampled points, procedural lake wallpaper (no reference pixels), BL deposit morph/flames/grain, TR face details.

judges.critique:
**Strengths**
- Layout, element positions and sizes match closely in all four quadrants; the 2x2 composition, phone frames, wheel and pill sizes are near-identical.
- Palette (lime/pink/yellow/purple/cyan rings, orange gradients, peach background) and the blob/avatar emoji styling are faithful.
- Typography families are correct: serif titles, grotesk sub-text, monospace Net Worth.

**Issues, by impact**
1. [BR] 1.35-2.0s, 3.4s: the wheel is much more blurred in NEW (soft disc, washed edges at 1.35 with a pale halo). REF is sharper with crisp segment edges. At 2.0s NEW segments look flatter and a more saturated green. Reduce blur radius, and match the segment two-tone contrast.
2. [BR] 3.4-4.6s: the Salary pill number in NEW is slightly heavier and larger. The wheel rim is a thicker, brighter white ring in NEW. Lower the glow opacity and reduce the number weight by about one step.
3. [TR] 1.0-2.9s: the 0x082E...CA88 text and avatar in NEW are about 3% larger and sit about 10px lower and right of REF. At 2.2s the $27.70M and +$22.24M columns have wider spacing. The face on the avatar has slightly different eyes. Tighten the gap and shift the row up.
4. [BL] 1.4-3.2s: the Net Worth phone card has orange flames that are cleaner and larger in NEW, with a pointed yellow tip at 1.4. REF shows a soft glow with no hard spike. The phone is about 5px right of REF. Blur the flames and shift left.
5. [BL] 2.6s: the Deposit button gradient in NEW is more saturated red-orange on the left, while REF is lighter coral to peach with a visible inner glow. Lighten the left stop and add an inner highlight. The glyph is slightly thinner in NEW.
6. [TL] 0.1-1.85s: serif title and sub-text are about 2px higher in NEW, and the badge pill (+34) is larger with bolder text. Icon glyphs are heavier in NEW: the bank and the Socials seal are drawn bolder than REF's thin outline strokes, and the wallet is bolder. Thin the strokes to about 1.5px.
7. [TL] 4.4-4.7s: the Credit line glass card in NEW is a more saturated green tint with less frosted grey and blur. REF is greyer and milkier during the transition. Raise the blur and the grey mix.
8. [BL] 5.3s: the Rewards and Credit values differ slightly in the digits, which is a counter timing issue rather than a layout one. The lime card gradient is a bit brighter in NEW.
9. [BR] 0.4s and 1.1s: the lake photo in NEW is brighter and has less contrast than REF, which is darker with a visible tree line. The phone bezel is thicker and there is a drop shadow under the phone. Darken the photo and match the bezel width.
10. [TR] 0.2s: the avatar blobs are essentially matched, but colors are slightly lighter in NEW at the fade-out frames.

**Strengths**
- Cut and beat timing across all four quadrants is within ~1-2 frames: card sequence, Net Worth count-up, Deposit press, wheel zoom-in, 2x burst, phone-to-credit-line zoom, wallet-chip dissolve and the 14.7s loop all line up at every sampled timestamp (0.1-14.5s).
- Odometer rolls (TL 1999-to-1000, BR Salary $3200-to-$6400) share direction, digit stagger and the final zoom-in.
- Cross-quadrant sync and loop seam look faithful.

**Differences, most impactful first**
1. [BR] 1.1-1.6s: wheel arrives much blurrier and softer than REF, and its edge fades to white later. The central $3200 is blurred in NEW at 1.35 but nearly sharp in REF. Shorten the defocus ramp so it is sharp by ~1.35s. NEW also looks about 5% larger at 1.6-2.0s, so reduce the scale overshoot and settle easing.
2. [BR] 2.5-3.4s: odometer digit phase differs. At 2.5 REF shows $322'/$32x with two stacked digits, NEW shows $32 with a different tail. At 3.4 REF shows $6_4 (tens in motion) while NEW shows $638 with a trailing ghost. The REF ones/tens columns roll at different speeds, with tens trailing. Retune per-digit speed offsets and easing.
3. [TL] 2.3-2.6s: gauge odometer in NEW has heavier vertical motion blur and wider digit spacing. At 2.3 REF shows 855 with a small blur, NEW shows 855 with a doubled ghost row below. At 2.6 REF is 199x, NEW is 1999 almost settled. Reduce blur radius and lag the settle by ~0.1s.
4. [TR] 4.4-4.7s: the unlock glass sweep is slightly ahead in NEW. At 4.7 NEW is already saturated lime with a crisp white lock, while REF is still grey-green with a faint, translucent lock. Delay the colour fill by ~0.1s and fade the lock in later. At 4.4 NEW shows a solid lock, REF a faint one.
5. [BL] 0.15s: NEW already shows 'Spend crypto as', REF only 'Spend crypto'. Word reveal is about 1 frame early, so delay words by ~0.05-0.08s. Also, at 3.2s the Deposit button in NEW sits slightly higher, so adjust the drift easing.
6. [TL] 0.8-1.85s: badge counters (+21 vs +22, +29 vs +31, +55 vs +59) run slightly ahead of REF. Use a more ease-out count curve, and arc stroke thickness differs slightly at card changes.
7. [TR] Chip fields: positions and fade are good, but 1.0-1.4s the faded chips in NEW look marginally brighter. Fade them a touch faster.

**Strengths**
- Layout, palette, typography, timing and per-quadrant choreography match closely; at normal speed it reads as the same video.
- Glass/blur/glow effects (credit-line unlock, wheel blur-in, odometer motion blur, deposit gradient) are convincingly reproduced.
- Loop sync across all four quadrants is tight.

**Differences (prioritized)**
1. [TL] 4.4-4.7s: REF unlock glass is a frosted grey pill with a faint pale lock and a soft green bloom that swells slowly. NEW shows a brighter, more saturated green core and a crisper, opaque white lock icon earlier. Fix: lower the glow opacity, fade the lock in later with lower alpha, add heavier backdrop blur and grey frost tint.
2. [BR] 0.4-1.1s: REF phone photo is darker and more contrasty with a saturated blue-green water tint and a cloud reflection. NEW is washed out and pale (hazy, flatter sky), and the phone bezel is thicker and more rounded. Fix: increase contrast/saturation, darken the lake, and thin the bezel.
3. [BR] 1.35-1.6s and 2.9-3.4s: REF wheel blur-in is softer with a wider white fade at the edges and finer spoke contrast. NEW has stronger, more uniform saturation and a harder rim. Pin 'Salary' text is lighter in NEW. Fix: reduce the blur-in radius mismatch, increase spoke contrast variation, and keep the label color a darker grey.
4. [TL] 2.3-2.9s gauge: NEW odometer digits are blurrier and bigger (tick blur smears the 855/1000 digits), and tick ring is slightly more saturated. Fix: reduce the vertical blur sigma on digits and match the digit size.
5. [TL] 0.1-1.9s cards: NEW title serif is slightly lighter/smaller, the +N badge sits a few px off, and icon glyphs are heavier (bank, swap icons look bolder). Counter values are drifting (+39 vs +38, +46 etc.). Fix: thin icon strokes and align the badge offset.
6. [BL] 1.8-2.2s: orange/yellow flame edges at the phone sides are more saturated and taller in NEW; Deposit pill gradient is more red-orange at the left than REF's softer peach. Fix: soften flame opacity and shift the pill gradient lighter.
7. [TR] The faces on the avatar bubbles are slightly bolder and the mid-teal bubbles slightly more saturated; minor.

notes: Round 3: SSIM-guided. TL sunburst rays measured exactly (12 rays/15°/−30°/s), gauge 61 ticks, per-frame odometer/badge values; BR phone motion refit + richer procedural lake; BL diagonal ribbons, pill rim, morph fixes.
